cs.t: I tried some Ikea mattresses when I was mattress shopping, and none of them felt comfortable even in a short test period in the store. I ended up buying a Leesa and have been very satisfied with it over the past 5 years.
cs.th: What happens to a mail-order mattress after you return it

cs.t: We pulled the trigger on a Leesa ( http://leesa.com ) and it's fantastic. I recommend them to anyone I know looking for a mattress. No pushy salesperson watching you awkwardly laying on a bed in a brightly lit open room and 100 nights to test it out? Sold
cs.th: Why are there so many mattress stores?
